intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Sriracha-sauce and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Sriracha sauce may contain gluten due to the potential use of wheat-based ingredients or cross-contamination during production. It's important to verify specific ingredients and preparation methods to ensure safety for those with coeliac disease.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Sriracha-sauce can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.
